stages.title: Option A Slab
stages.desc: RC raft slab on blinding and compacted hardcore, with the perimeter insulation (BR11).

stages.title: Option A Slab + ICF
stages.desc: Nudura 6" XR35 ICF walls as populated, with the opening end caps and lintels.

stages.title: Option A Slab finishes
stages.desc: DPM, 2x100 PIR / XPS insulation, 75 screed, threshold infills and ACO drains.

stages.title: Option A ICF + steel
stages.desc: Structural steel in situ (engineer 26-92-01 C) and the load-bearing masonry walls for context.

stages.title: Option A Trusses + roof
stages.desc: Curved timber trusses, Comflor roof slabs and the green roof build-up.
